content:
We have IR spectrum with peaks: 3550, 3475 (likely O-H), 3100-3069 (C-H aromatic), 1737 (C=O carbonyl stretch), 1596,1586 (aromatic C=C). So carbonyl peak at 1737 cm-1 suggests presence of carbonyl group. Need number of carbonyl groups. Could be one carbonyl. Could be more but only one strong carbonyl stretch. Usually each carbonyl gives a strong peak around 1700-1750. If multiple carbonyls, may see multiple peaks. Only one observed. So answer likely 1.

We could also verify with carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shift ~200 ppm. But IR already indicates one. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR for carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
